resources.string:
To toggle auto rotation, use the notification rather than the system auto rotation setting.


Each time you enable auto rotation, the direction the screen was facing will be treated as the direction you are facing, so rotating the device will cause the screen to face that direction.


To change your own orientation (eg. lie down): 
1. Disable auto rotation 
2. Rotate the device until the screen faces the direction you want 
3. Re-enable auto rotation
If you want to uninstall this app, please use the corresponding menu item in this screen to ensure the default screen rotation is not left in the wrong state.
